title: S5_func_distortion_correction QC Status
description: QC status schema for S5_func_distortion_correction step (aggregated per dataset key)

dataset_key.description: Dataset key identifying the regression dataset

status.description: Aggregate status across all runs in this dataset

failure_message.description: Aggregate failure / warning summary (null if PASS)

run_id.description: BIDS run filename stem (without _bold.nii.gz) or null

metrics.description: Distortion correction metrics for this run

mean_before_voxels.description: Number of finite voxels in the temporal mean of the pre-S5 BOLD

mean_after_voxels.description: Number of finite voxels in the temporal mean of the post-S5 BOLD

mi_before.description: Mutual information between pre-S5 mean BOLD and anat (in BOLD geometry); null when anat resampling failed

mi_after.description: Mutual information between post-S5 mean BOLD and anat (in BOLD geometry)

mi_delta_pct.description: Percentage change in MI (after vs before)

cospine_skip_reason.description: When CoSpine-style metrics could not be computed, this records why (anat unavailable, deepseg failure, no Z coverage). Absent when metrics computed normally.

per_slice_z.description: BOLD Z-indices that were scored (intersection of anat cord coverage and EPI cord coverage)

displacement_before_mm.description: Per-slice |Y-centroid(EPI cord) − Y-centroid(anat cord)| in mm, before distortion correction

displacement_after_mm.description: Per-slice A–P cord-centerline displacement in mm, after correction

dice_per_slice_before.description: Per-slice 2D Dice (EPI cord ∩ anat cord), before correction

dice_3d_before.description: 3D Dice pooled over all evaluated slices (CoSpine-style)

orient_axcodes.description: Affine-derived axis codes of the BOLD (e.g. 'RAS', 'LPI'); used to locate the A-P axis for centroid extraction.

ap_axis_index.description: 0-based BOLD voxel-axis index that maps to anterior-posterior (typically 1 for RAS-like BOLD).

smooth_window.description: Savitzky-Golay window length applied to the per-slice Y(z) cord-centroid trace.

min_voxels_per_slice.description: Floor on cord voxels per slice for inclusion in centroid/Dice traces.

failure_reasons.description: List of failure / warning reasons (empty if PASS)

failure_message.description: Semicolon-joined failure_reasons or null when none

reportlets.description: Paths (relative to out_dir) to QC reportlet files

slice_displacement.description: Path to per-slice A–P cord-centerline displacement PNG (CoSpine-style)

cord_dice_per_slice.description: Path to per-slice 2D cord-Dice (EPI ∩ anat) PNG (CoSpine-style)

distortion_correction_mode.description: Mode actually executed; downstream (S6) reads this to handle SyN-fallback runs differently
